## Why This Is Asked

// In Azure Function (Node.js)
const csv = toCsv(userData)
await blobClient.uploadBuffer(Buffer.from(csv));
const sas = generateBlobSASQueryParameters({

  blobName,
  permissions: BlobSASPermissions.parse('r'),
  expiresOn: new Date(Date.now() + 1000 * 60 * 60) // 1 hour
